name: leadhub
description: Read-only access to the Leadhub MCP server: businesses, campaigns, products, interest lists, RFM, and analytics. Includes six analytics workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Read Leadhub data: analytics, campaigns, products, lists, RFM.
interface.longDescription: Connects to the Leadhub MCP server. All tools are read-only: businesses, campaigns, products, interest lists, RFM profiles, and analytics. Six bundled workflows cover period review, email, SMS, retention, RFM, and traffic. Analytics tools return one period at a time; a comparison is a second call. Money from email and SMS tools is in the business primary currency.
defaultPrompt: Summarize this business for the last 30 days against the previous 30.
Explain why email revenue changed in the selected period.
Find my latest email campaign and show its results.
